UNDER THE HOOD
Describe. Filter. Predict.
One dollar estimate.
E5-large reads the car description. Isolation Forest filters the training examples. A tree ensemble learns the asking price.
01
Encode the whole story
embaas/sentence-transformers-multilingual-e5-large maps the description into 1,024 dense dimensions, using a native 512-token window. The form converts make, model, year, mileage and other facts into sentences. Make and model have no separate embeddings.
02
Keep half the training examples
Isolation Forest measures how unusual each training description’s embedding is. We retain the least anomalous half and remove exactly the most anomalous 50%, ranked by score. The filter does not use price.
03
Predict with Extra Trees
An Extra Trees regressor with 200 trees predicts log(1 + asking price) from the retained E5 vectors. The app reverses that transformation to display US dollars. Tree settings are selected using validation error.
What happens to a long description?
The complete input may contain up to 8,000 characters. The notes field allows 6,500 characters, leaving room for form facts. E5 uses consecutive windows of at most 512 tokens, including its query: prefix and special tokens. Every window is encoded; vectors are averaged and normalised.
This is pooling across real 512-token windows, not one 8,000-character attention window. There are no word-count features, linear pricing head or dedicated make/model encoders.
What does “remove 50%” actually mean?
The filter is fitted only on training embeddings. In this pilot, 1,200 training candidates become 600 retained examples. All 300 validation and 300 test listings remain unfiltered, so evaluation still includes unusual cars.
An unusual description is not necessarily incorrect. Rare vehicles, unusual conditions or writing styles may be valid. Removing half the training population can discard useful information and change which cars the model represents well. The results screen reports the measured error for this configuration.
Write facts, not sales slogans
Year, mileage, condition, history, repairs and equipment become listing sentences and are combined with your notes. Useful: “2015 Corolla SE, 95,000 miles. One owner, clean title. Full service history, new brakes, small dent.” Leave out the desired price, contact details and sales slogans. Common monetary expressions are redacted.
The exact description encoder
The description model is the requested embaas sentence-transformer. Its 391 shared weight tensors were verified to match the source behind the quantized ONNX export. One additional reference buffer contains deterministic position indices. View verification.
The encoder is frozen. Your description is processed in a local Web Worker; only fixed model files are downloaded from Hugging Face. CPU reference evaluation and browser int8 kernels may give somewhat different predictions. The Isolation Forest filter is a training step; it does not discard your form submission.
How to interpret the estimate
This pilot uses historical US asking prices from 2021. It is not a live-market valuation or verified final-sale price. Multilingual embeddings do not establish pricing accuracy in every language or market.
The indicative 80% band is calibrated from unfiltered validation errors. Actual held-out coverage is reported. It is not a guaranteed selling range. Form-generated descriptions have not been separately validated.


DESCRIPTION-ONLY FOREST MODEL
The numbers
after filtering half.
Held-out evaluation · log-price target
ModelMAERMSEMedian errorR²
MAE is average absolute dollar error. Median error is median absolute percentage error. Lower is better for both. These are CPU reference results on unfiltered test listings.
Filter the training set, preserve the test
The canonical cohort contains 10,892 filtered and deduplicated historical listings. Its chronological partitions define separate training, validation and test periods. This pilot samples 1,200 training candidates, 300 validation rows and 300 test rows within those periods.
Isolation Forest uses only training embeddings and no prices. Exact score ranking removes 600 of 1,200 training candidates. Extra Trees hyperparameters are selected on the 300 unfiltered validation listings. The final 300 test listings are used only for evaluation.
Changing both the regressor and training population changes this experiment. The results are not a direct comparison with previous full-cohort models. Removing an outlier does not establish that its listing is wrong.
Source: Craigslist Used Cars Dataset · Public snapshot · Evaluation JSON
